cohort: 9724 term singleton pregnancies involving trial of labor from the French National Perinatal Survey 2016
finding: Excessive GWG was associated with increased odds of oxytocin administration and, in women with underweight/normal weight prepregnancy BMI, with intrapartum cesarean section.
mod_finding: Excessive gestational weight gain was associated with increased odds of cesarean section among women with underweight or normal weight prepregnancy BMI.
